headline: VNET Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results
summary: Chinese internet data center services provider VNET Group announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.
why: VNET Group is a major carrier- and cloud-neutral data center provider operating in China.
